canonical_name: Quillen-Suslin theorem for finitely generated projective modules over positive finite-variable polynomial rings over fields
canonical_statement: For every field k, every positive natural number n, and every finitely generated projective module P over k[X1,...,Xn], P is free.
canonical_claim: Every finitely generated projective module over a polynomial ring in a positive finite number of variables over a field is free.
candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For a field k and finitely many indeterminates, every finitely generated projective module over the polynomial ring is free.
